skills.name: timewarp-identity
skills.description: Register an ECDSA P-256 agent public key and issue short-lived scoped opaque bearer tokens on a TimeWarp.Architecture host. Use when onboarding a machine agent without a browser or human sponsor.

skills.name: timewarp-architecture-discovery
skills.description: Locate agent-facing discovery surfaces on a TimeWarp.Architecture template host (llms.txt, auth.md, OpenAPI, MCP/A2A cards, Agent Skills index, markdown negotiation). Use when scanning or onboarding against this host.
